description: Nonsecret identifier prefixes that may appear in evidence records and artifacts, and the patterns that must never appear. Both lists are read by packages/evidence rules and by the recorder. Extend by adding a prefix seen in a real provider readback, with the date.

id_prefixes.biz_: business or connected account, seen in sandbox readback 2026-09-08
id_prefixes.key_: API key id without secret, documented
id_prefixes.lafm_: fee markup, seen in sandbox readback run-2026-09-08c BUILD-16
id_prefixes.hook_: webhook endpoint, seen in sandbox readback run-2026-09-08c BUILD-18
id_prefixes.whdel_: webhook delivery, seen in sandbox readback run-2026-09-08c BUILD-19

notes: Card pattern catches sandbox test cards too; record the card as a name such as sandbox-success-card, never the number. IBAN pattern is coarse on purpose. Test placeholders must stay under eight characters after the prefix, for example sk_x or ws_x; sk_test_placeholder_not_real is caught on purpose.
